text:
Maya: Quick sync — onboarding "long-context-v2". We pushed weights to s3://redwood-models/long-context-v2/ (sha: a1b2c3). Need signoff on tokenizer quirks, max_ctx, kv-cache format, and memory profile. I'm listing known items, pls reply w/ checks.

Jin: I pulled the weights. tokenizer.json uses a special token <sep> at id 50265; merges differ from base. I saw token offsets shift by +1 in a few cases — tests failed for trailing-space sequences.

Priya: Re: max_ctx — model config has "max_position_embeddings": 65536 but our kv-cache code defaults to 32768. Need config validation so runtime errors early instead of corrupt cache maps.

Alex: Ran a quick smoke with --max_ctx 65536 on p3.2xlarge and hit OOM after ~1.2k tokens gen. Log: "RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GiB..." Suggest trying kvcache format v2 (packed) + 4-bit quant to reduce footprint.

Theo: There's a PR that adds packed-kv support: PR #2456 (link). It also adds a streaming fallback: if max_ctx > 32768 we auto-enable streaming and log a warning. Can we land that before onboarding?

Maya: Can someone run the memory-sizing script on dedicated CI? Command: `python infra/mem_profile.py --model s3://redwood-models/long-context-v2 --ctx 65536 --batch 1`. Also tokenization smoke: `python tests/tokenizer_check.py --model-path s3://redwood-models/long-context-v2`

Jin: I'll run mem_profile tonight on dedicated-gpu-1. If it OOMs, I'll retry with `--quant 4` and `--kv-format v2`.

infra-bot: CI: mem-profile/dedicated-gpu-1 started for 1773001234 by Jin.

Priya: Also watch out: tokenizer emits an extra BOS token when input starts with a newline. That shifts positions by 1 and can push cache indexing to max_position_embeddings+1 => OOB. We need to normalize on load (strip leading newlines or dedupe BOS).

Alex: Small config snippet for runtime validation: 
```json
{
  "model": "long-context-v2",
  "max_position_embeddings": 65536,
  "kv_cache_format": "v2",
  "quantization": "4bit",
  "streaming_fallback": true
}
```

Theo: Ping @Maya for PR review: I added a validator in runtime to compare model config against served config and error early.

Maya: on it. I can review later today. If validator passes, we can proceed. Also tagging @SRE for autoscale: we may need extra headroom for long context tests.

infra-bot: CI: mem-profile/dedicated-gpu-1 failed (OOM) — see logs: /ci/logs/1773001234/mem-profile.log

Jin: Log excerpt:
```
AllocationError: Unable to allocate 5.5 GiB (GPU 0; 14.73 GiB total capacity; 8.2 GiB already allocated)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "generate.py", line 312, in <module>
    out = model.generate(input_ids, max_new_tokens=1024)
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory.
```

Priya: Ok plan: 1) enforce tokenizer normalization on load (strip leading newline insertions), 2) default kv_cache_format to v2 for this model, 3) add mem-safety CI that runs with `--quant 4` and checks allocation delta, 4) limit max_served_ctx to 49152 until autoscale validated.

Alex: I can submit PR with runtime validator + tokenizer fix + default kv format. Will include unit tests and a small reproducer for the OOM case.

Maya: Sounds good. Approve once PR landed. Also update model registry metadata with weights sha and tokenizer note.

Theo: Note for docs: update "Known tokenizer quirks" and "Recommended runtime flags" pages.

Maya: Thanks all. I'll mark this thread for follow-up tomorrow. :thumbsup:
